modules.title: Everything you need to get results
modules.subtitle: From the intake form to a plan for months ahead — DonatelleX guides you every step of the way.

items.title: Personal start
items.description: 2 minutes of questions — and your program is ready, matched to your goal, level and place to train.

items.title: A clear plan for months
items.description: Every day is planned ahead: exercises, sets, weight. No improvising at the gym.

items.title: Video for every exercise
items.description: Watch the technique right before your set — never guess if you're doing it right.

items.title: Rest timer
items.description: Counts down your rest between sets and exercises automatically — keeps your pace for you.

items.title: Progress diary
items.description: Weight, measurements, workout history — all your progress in one place.

items.title: Grows with you
items.description: Nutrition, store, courses, AI coach — the platform keeps evolving, not standing still.

weeklyPlan.title: Know exactly what to do every day
weeklyPlan.subtitle: Your program is mapped out week by week for months ahead: strength days, cardio, rest. Load builds up gradually, and the built-in timer counts your rest between sets and exercises.
weeklyPlan.footerNote: Recovery and sleep are part of the program, not a pause in it.

benefits.title: Weekly progression
benefits.description: Load increases gradually and deliberately — no random jumps, no plateaus.

benefits.title: Built-in rest timer
benefits.description: Counts your rest between sets and exercises automatically — no need to watch the clock.

benefits.title: Zero improvisation
benefits.description: You know in advance what exercise is next and how many sets — no thinking it through at the gym.

pricing.title: First results in just a few weeks
pricing.subtitle: Pay once for the period you choose — no auto-renewal, no card on file.

items.title: Sign up — free
items.description: Email or Google. Under a minute, no card needed.

items.title: First week — free
items.description: Full access to your program for a week, before you pay a cent.

items.title: Train the plan
items.description: Open the app and do what's written — no wondering what to train today.

items.question: Do I need special equipment?
items.answer: No. Many programs are built around bodyweight training. For programs that use weights, we tell you exactly what equipment you'll need before the workout starts.

items.question: I've never trained before — will this work for me?
items.answer: Yes. You tell us your fitness level in the intake form, and the first weeks are a gradual ramp-up, not maximum load from day one.

items.question: I've tried working out before and quit — why would this be different?
items.answer: People usually quit not from laziness, but from having to decide what to do every single time. DonatelleX removes that decision for you — the program is already mapped out for months ahead, all you do is open the app and follow it.

items.question: How long does a workout take?
items.answer: 40–90 minutes on average, depending on the program and the day — you see the full length before you start.

items.question: Will I be charged automatically when my period ends?
items.answer: No. Payment is one-time, only for the period you choose. When it ends, access simply stops — no automatic charges. Want to continue? You pay for a new period yourself, whenever you like.

items.question: What payment methods do you support?
items.answer: Visa, Mastercard and ArCa bank cards. Payment is processed on the bank's secure page — we never see or store your card details. It's a one-time payment with no automatic renewals.

items.question: Does the app work offline?
items.answer: DonatelleX is a PWA (Progressive Web App): the interface and previously viewed workouts are available offline, and your progress syncs once you're back online.

items.question: What languages does the app support?
items.answer: The interface is fully available in 10 languages: Russian, English, Español, Deutsch, Italiano, Українська, العربية, हिन्दी, ਪੰਜਾਬੀ, Հայերեն — switch instantly in settings. The workout programs themselves are currently in Russian; the English version is already being translated.

cta.title: Stop putting it off until Monday
cta.subtitle: Your first week is free. In a couple of minutes you'll have a plan for today — not another reason to wait.
cta.noCard: No payment now. Pay once for the period you choose — no subscription, no auto-renewal.

terms.title: Terms of use (public offer)
terms.intro: Please read these terms — they cover the subscription, payment, refunds and training safety.

sections.p: These terms are a public offer. By registering in the DonatelleX app or paying for a subscription, you accept them in full. The service is intended for people aged 18 and over.
Access to the app at app.donatellex.com for the paid period: training programs by coach Vladimir Donatellex, exercise videos, nutrition and recovery recommendations, and progress statistics.

The subscription is paid once for the chosen period (1, 3, 6 or 12 months); there are no automatic renewals or charges. The price is shown on the payment page. By accepting these terms at checkout, you request that access starts immediately — it opens automatically as soon as the bank confirms the payment.

You can withdraw from the subscription within 14 days of payment without giving a reason. Because access starts immediately, the cost of the days used is kept in proportion to the subscription length, and the rest is refunded within 14 days. See the Refund policy for details.

Programs, exercises and nutrition tips are general recommendations, not a medical service, diagnosis or treatment, and they do not take your individual health into account. Consult a doctor before starting training or changing your diet — especially if you have chronic conditions, injuries, heart, blood pressure or joint problems, or are pregnant or have recently given birth. Use proper technique, start with manageable weights and stop an exercise if you feel pain, dizziness or unwell.

You train voluntarily, independently and at your own risk. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for injuries, deterioration of health or other harm arising from doing the exercises or following the recommendations, including where you did not consult a doctor or used incorrect technique. This does not limit any liability that cannot be excluded by law.

Your account is personal — do not share access with others. All materials (videos, programs, texts) are protected by copyright and may not be copied, recorded, published or sold. We may block an account for violations.
The free week (one program, 7 days from registration), the month for inviting a friend and gifted access are provided free of charge; their conditions may change.
We may update these terms; the new version applies from its publication on this page. A period already paid for continues under the previous terms.

These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Armenia. If you are a consumer in another country, you keep the mandatory rights granted by your country's law. We try to resolve disputes through negotiation — write to us.
The seller is a sole proprietor registered in the Republic of Armenia; the seller's details will be published in this section before payments are accepted. Contact: hello@donatellex.com.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body: DonatelleX processes personal data in accordance with applicable data protection law. The full privacy policy will be published here before the platform's production launch.

regionNotes.am: For users in Armenia, personal data is processed in accordance with the Law of the Republic of Armenia “On Protection of Personal Data”.
regionNotes.ru: For users in Russia, personal data is processed in accordance with Federal Law No. 152-FZ "On Personal Data".
regionNotes.eu: For users in the European Union, personal data is processed in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
regionNotes.us: For users in the United States, applicable state consumer privacy laws apply.

refund.title: Refund policy
refund.intro: A short, honest guide to cancelling your DonatelleX subscription and getting your money back.

sections.p: You can withdraw from a paid subscription within 14 calendar days of payment — no reason needed.
In the app: Profile → “Cancel subscription & refund” → “Withdraw and get a refund”. Or email hello@donatellex.com with your account email and payment date.

If you accepted the terms of the offer at checkout, access starts right after payment — so on withdrawal we keep the cost of the days you have already used, in proportion to the subscription length, and refund the rest. Example: a 3-month subscription (91 days) cancelled on day 10 — we refund 81/91 of the amount.

Refunds are made no later than 14 days after we receive your request, using the same payment method. When it reaches your card depends on your bank — usually 3–10 business days. Access to paid programs ends once the refund is approved.

After 14 days the remaining period is not refunded, and you keep access until the end of the paid period. There are no automatic renewals or charges. If the service was not provided or did not work as described through our fault, email hello@donatellex.com and we'll refund the period not provided.
The free week, the month for inviting a friend and gifted access are not paid for and are not refundable.
This policy does not limit the rights you have under the consumer protection laws of your country.
Refund questions: hello@donatellex.com. The seller's details are listed in the terms of use.
